# Keep It Up

A habit tracker that helps you build consistency or break habits you want to leave behind.

## Features

- Track habits with customisable frequency (daily, 3×/week, 2×/week, weekly, flexible)
- Log strength workouts with sets, reps, and weight
- Track avoidance habits with daily check-ins
- View weekly consistency, progress trends, and volume totals
- Weekly review with adaptive suggestions
- 30/60/90-day challenge mode
- Repeat last session with one tap
- All data stored locally in the browser
